must_identify.item: The kubelet is restarting the container because the liveness probe fails
must_identify.evidence: As a result, kubelet repeatedly failed liveness checks against the dead port and killed the container with exit code 137 approximately every 45–70 seconds [10], producing the "crash loop" pattern reported in the alert.

must_identify.item: The probe targets port 8081 while the app listens on 8080
must_identify.evidence: The root cause is confirmed: the `api` Deployment's livenessProbe was configured to check port 8081 [6], while the application only ever listens on port 8080, as shown in its startup logs ("api listening on :8080")

notes: The RCA explicitly rules out OOM and an application crash. It never states a remediation such as setting the liveness port back to 8080; it only mentions rollback history as unchecked. Its claim that last-applied-configuration shows port 8080 may be worth verifying.
